description:
## Crossfade (YouTube Music)

Crossfade has been rewritten to address the loud burst at the start of the next song reported in #45.

- **Fades the audio itself:** The new song now starts silent from its very first sample and fades in, while
  its playback volume stays the same throughout. Before, the new song started at volume 0 and the volume was
  raised, which is the most likely trigger of the burst on HyperOS. If you had the burst, please report back.
- **Song/video switch works with crossfade on:** Switching between song and video no longer shows
  "Video mode is not available". The switch is instant and never starts a crossfade, even in the middle of one.
- **Pause, seek and speed:** Pausing during a crossfade pauses the fade too. Seeking and playback speed changes
  keep the fade in step with the music.
- **End of the queue:** The last song in the queue plays to its end normally, also after seeking close to the end.
  Repeat one and Repeat all still crossfade.

Crossfade is still available on YouTube Music 9.00 and newer.

This is a development prerelease, not a stable release.

Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-13.
